prompts.male: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production animation sprite sheet for the 2D side scrolling game Send Love. Reference image is identity and art style ONLY. Create a complete 4-column by 3-row sprite sheet on REAL TRANSPARENT background, ideally 2048x1536. Exactly 12 evenly sized rectangular cells, NO lines, NO text, NO labels. One FULL BODY male squirrel per cell, facing RIGHT in side/three-quarter side view, with identical scale, design and feet baseline, entire huge tail and ears inside each cell with ample padding. Preserve reference brown and cream fur, backwards red cap, red hoodie, charcoal trousers, red-white shoes, cute big eyes, smooth shaded polished cartoon 2D artwork with clean dark outlines. NO floating hearts baked into the sheet. Order left to right top to bottom: 0 relaxed standing with hands down; 1 same standing eyes closed blink; 2 leaning BACK drawing a slingshot with both hands at chest, determined; 3 leaning back further, arms bent pulling hard; 4 releasing hands FORWARD with excited focused face; 5 follow-through leaning forward; 6 waiting with hands forward as if holding a butterfly-net handle (DO NOT DRAW THE NET); 7 catching reaction with hands forward and amazed happy face; 8 celebrating arms up joyful; 9 celebrating crouched happy bounce; 10 sad head down ears down with tears, mouth downturned, hands down; 11 sad wiping a tear with lowered tail. No props, no slingshot, no net, no ground, no shadows outside body. Make 12 distinct readable poses with consistent character identity. The result will be cropped into 12 animation frames.

prompts.forest: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D side scrolling game background, landscape 16:9 2048x1152. A beautiful warm lush forest at squirrel treehouse height, matching the reference polished cartoon 2D squirrel game style: expressive smooth illustrated shapes, rich warm brown bark, vibrant emerald and sage foliage, honey golden light, high quality clean dark contours and painterly soft cel shading. Dense old trees and layered soft-focus foliage extend into the distance, little flowers, mushrooms at far bottom, golden dust in sunlight. Mid upper 70 percent should be light open misty forest with scattered distant thin trunks, plenty of visual clarity for paper airplane flight. Close large trunks ONLY at outermost extreme edges; no branches or objects across middle flight space. Slight hill and ferns in bottom 15 percent. Full bleed illustration, not a mockup, no interface, no lettering, NO CHARACTERS NO buildings NO paper planes NO slingshot. Artwork will be used as a scrolling forest background behind separately rendered tree platforms.
prompts.tree: Use case: stylized-concept. Production standalone foreground TREEHOUSE PLATFORM sprite for a polished 2D side scroller about squirrels sending love letters. Real TRANSPARENT background. One enormous warm brown old tree TRUNK extending from top to bottom at LEFTMOST 30 percent of a square image, with an inviting oval hollow treehouse doorway at about 60 percent image height, tiny wooden heart sign and leafy awning above the hollow. A thick sturdy natural mossy BRANCH grows to the RIGHT from the base of the hollow at 78 percent image height, extending nearly to the right edge, flat enough for a character and slingshot to stand on. Thick rounded branch with visible bark knots, a few twigs and leaves below it. Tree canopy green clusters only at the very top. Cute polished cartoon game illustration, dark clean outlines, orange brown bark with shaded volume, lush saturated green leaves, golden rim light, high quality consistent with the supplied squirrel character reference. NO squirrels, NO characters, NO props on the branch, no grass ground, NO background. Preserve all branch edges and transparent negative space above branch. Square 1536x1536.
prompts.slingshot: Use case stylized-concept. Standalone production prop sprite for Send Love cartoon 2D side scrolling squirrel game. A beautiful handcrafted wooden Y-shaped slingshot fixed upright on a small mossy wooden support, smooth warm brown bark grain, light carved heart on the handle, twine binding at two fork tips, polished dark outlines and soft golden cel shading like the reference. Strict side view. Symmetrical fork tips near top at x25% and x75%, fork join middle, long vertical handle to bottom. NO rubber bands, NO pouch, NO projectile, these will be drawn dynamically by the game. Completely transparent background, no characters, no letters, no ground scene. Single isolated centered object with generous transparent margins. Square sprite.
prompts.net: Use case stylized-concept. Standalone production catching-net sprite for Send Love polished cartoon 2D side scrolling squirrel game. A large butterfly net held upright: narrow upright oval opening on the LEFT of the basket at x20% y35%, mouth faces LEFT toward incoming paper plane, net basket trails horizontally to RIGHT toward x90%, long warm brown wooden handle descends from bottom of oval toward x35% y92%. Oval rim is honey-colored wood wrapped with pink ribbon, woven cream-green net is visibly translucent with fine diamond mesh. Opening must be readable as a vertical ellipse, net bag extends right of rim. High quality clean dark outlines, warm soft cel shading and rounded design matching the reference squirrel illustration. NO character, NO paper plane, NO letters, NO hands. Real transparent background. One isolated net centered with full handle visible, generous transparent padding. Square sprite.
